sources.title: Visa-free access or visa-on-arrival for HKSAR Passport
sources.publisher: Immigration Department, Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
sources.officialityEvidence: The live HKSAR Immigration Department nationality selector expressly applies to the HKSAR Passport and returns Ecuador with a 90-day stay. Its combined heading does not itself fix issuance timing, so the category comes from the underlying visa-abolition agreement.

sources.title: Visa-free arrangement for HKSAR passport holders
sources.publisher: Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region
sources.officialityEvidence: The live info.gov.hk Government archive records the HKSAR Secretary for Security signing the reciprocal Ecuador Visa Abolition Agreement, its 3 October 1999 effective date, and the exact HKSAR-passport visitor entitlement. The current Immigration Department list continues to include Ecuador at the same 90-day duration.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The Agreement gives visa-free access for a period up to 90 days to HKSAR passport holders visiting Ecuador.

sources.title: Ecuador will require a transitory visitor visa from 1 September 2025
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Human Mobility
sources.officialityEvidence: Ecuador's live Foreign Ministry announcement gives the operative 1 September 2025 visitor-visa list. It names the People's Republic of China but does not identify Hong Kong SAR or Macao SAR passports as distinct travel documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: a aquellos nacionales de los países a los que actualmente se les solicita visa para ingresar al país

sources.title: Travel Convenience Privilege
sources.publisher: Identification Services Bureau of the Macao Special Administrative Region
sources.officialityEvidence: The live DSI service identifies the Macao SAR Passport as its travel document and its possible output groups as visa-free access or visa on arrival, eVisa, and automated clearance. Its dynamic interface did not expose a direct Ecuador result or issuance method; portal presence is not used as eligibility evidence.

policies.title: Ecuador: HKSAR ordinary passports visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Ecuador's reciprocal Visa Abolition Agreement expressly gives HKSAR passport holders visa-free visits up to 90 days; the live HKSAR Immigration Department list continues to show Ecuador with a 90-day stay.
conditions: Applies to HKSAR passport holders visiting Ecuador for up to 90 days under the reciprocal Visa Abolition Agreement.
The 1999 agreement took effect on 3 October 1999; the current HKSAR Immigration Department Ecuador entry still displays a 90-day stay.
Employment, residence, study, non-HKSAR travel documents, passport validity, health, security and final border-admission requirements remain outside this short-visitor policy.

unresolved.reason: No current Ecuadorian source directly maps a Macao SAR passport to an Ecuador visitor route. Ecuador's PRC nationality listing is not transferred, and the live Macao DSI interface did not provide a reproducible Ecuador issuance result.
